speaker.name: Automation Alex
speaker.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

output.objection: I am not giving up KPI governance, I am just sequencing the work so the audit trail is solid before we tighten the review steps. You cannot audit a metric that has no stable definition, so the audit must land first.
output.correction: I did not say the KPI definitions should stay unreviewed forever, I said the formal sign off comes after the audit infrastructure is in place. Do not file this as a refusal to govern, it is a dependency order.
